summary: Added the web testing foundation with Vitest, React Testing Library, jsdom, MSW handlers for the implemented public home contract, and a sequential Playwright matrix covering Arabic, English, and Simplified Chinese across desktop, tablet, and mobile device scopes. Added visual baselines, accessibility checks, and harness tests, then synchronized the workspace dependency policy.

Web source, tests, and harness configuration linted with zero warnings.
6 harness tests passed, including locale direction, all 9 matrix combinations, UX retry state, and the implemented public home MSW contract.

18 Playwright tests passed across 3 locales and desktop/tablet/mobile projects using one deterministic worker.

Root syntax, contracts, API, and web typechecks passed.

Contracts, API, client, and SSR builds passed.

scopeNotes: MSW intercepts only the implemented GET /api/v1/public/home contract using a same-origin test host; no production mock or invented endpoint was added.
The workspace dependency allow-list was updated because the repository's root lint gate intentionally rejects unapproved workspace dependencies.
The Playwright matrix uses Chromium device presets for the approved desktop, tablet, and mobile scopes; no WebKit coverage claim is made.
knownGaps: Local Node v22.18.0 is below the repository's declared Node >=24 <25 baseline; all mandatory checks passed under the available runtime.
